Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4004822. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4004822'. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Return the specified columns. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
